headline: A useful answer is not yet a trustworthy record.
lede: Long-running work fails when important state has no durable place to be written, corrected, or reconciled.

items.label: Write
items.title: A fact never becomes shared state
items.body: One agent learns something important, but the next tool or session has no authoritative place to read it.

items.label: Correct
items.title: The old answer keeps returning
items.body: A correction fixes one conversation while another agent continues to act on the value it already had.

items.label: Reconcile
items.title: Conflicting sources disappear into one sentence
items.body: When two sources disagree, ordinary memory hides the conflict instead of preserving what each source said.
